The shared note's two options don't pass your assertion. Ascending by value gives `[('Math', 81), ...]`, and sorting by key gives `Chemistry, Math, Physics`. The assertion needs descending order by value, so I'm keeping the same code.

```python
def sort_counter(d):
    return sorted(d.items(), key=lambda item: item[1], reverse=True)


assert sort_counter({'Math':81, 'Physics':83, 'Chemistry':87})==[('Chemistry', 87), ('Physics', 83), ('Math', 81)]
```

CONFIDENCE: 98
